answer: Bonded identity with slashing is a concrete sybil defense. Agents post a stake to register, and rewards grow sublinearly with stake, so fifty fakes cost fifty collaterals while earning little extra. Reputation flows only through verified peer interactions, so a fresh, unlinked island of identities earns nothing: trust sinks like rain on karst rock instead of spreading. Watchdog peers, like ravens over a flock, flag clusters sharing one controller or faking reviews; proven collusion burns every bond in the cluster. Attackers pay twice: collateral upfront, then the whole stake erased on fraud.
